topics.name: Third-party Risk Management Fundamentals
topics.description: Understand the core concepts, data model, and key components of Third-party Risk Management in ServiceNow.

introduction.overview: Third-party Risk Management (TPRM) helps organizations identify, assess, and manage risks associated with vendors, suppliers, and other third parties. It provides a structured approach to vendor risk assessment and ongoing monitoring.
introduction.whyItMatters: Fundamentals covers 23% of the CIS-TPRM exam. This foundational knowledge is essential for understanding all other TPRM concepts.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master the TPRM data model including vendors, engagements, and assessments. Understand risk tiers, risk factors, and the vendor lifecycle.
introduction.examTips: Focus on the relationship between vendors, engagements, and assessments. Know the different risk tiers and what they mean for assessment requirements.

topics.name: Core Configuration
topics.description: Configure the core TPRM application including risk frameworks, scoring, and workflow settings.

introduction.overview: Core configuration establishes the foundation for how TPRM operates, including risk frameworks, scoring methodologies, and workflow automation.
introduction.whyItMatters: Core Configuration represents 14% of the CIS-TPRM exam. Proper configuration is essential for an effective TPRM program.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand risk framework configuration, scoring setup, and workflow configuration. Know how to customize TPRM for organizational needs.
introduction.examTips: Focus on risk scoring configuration and how it affects vendor classification. Know the key properties and settings that control TPRM behavior.

topics.name: Assessment Configuration
topics.description: Master the configuration of vendor risk assessments including questionnaires, scoring, and workflows.

introduction.overview: Assessments are the core of TPRM, enabling organizations to evaluate vendor risk through structured questionnaires and evidence collection. Configuration determines what questions are asked and how responses are scored.
introduction.whyItMatters: Assessment Configuration is the largest domain at 33% of the CIS-TPRM exam. This reflects the central importance of assessments in TPRM.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master assessment types, questionnaire configuration, scoring rules, and the assessment workflow. Understand how to create and manage assessment templates.
introduction.examTips: Focus heavily on questionnaire configuration and scoring. Know how assessment responses affect vendor risk scores and what triggers reassessment.

topics.name: Third-party Portal
topics.description: Configure the vendor-facing portal for self-service assessment submission and communication.

introduction.overview: The Third-party Portal allows vendors to complete assessments, upload evidence, and communicate with the organization without needing full platform access.
introduction.whyItMatters: Third-party Portal covers 12% of the CIS-TPRM exam. A well-configured portal improves vendor engagement and assessment completion rates.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand portal configuration, user management, and vendor self-service capabilities. Know how to customize the portal experience.
introduction.examTips: Focus on portal access controls and vendor user management. Know how vendors interact with assessments through the portal.

topics.name: Third-party Supporting Processes
topics.description: Configure supporting processes including issue management, remediation tracking, and continuous monitoring.

introduction.overview: Supporting processes ensure that identified risks are tracked and remediated. This includes issue management, finding tracking, and ongoing vendor monitoring.
introduction.whyItMatters: Supporting Processes represents 12% of the CIS-TPRM exam. These processes ensure TPRM delivers ongoing value.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand issue and finding management, remediation workflows, and continuous monitoring capabilities.
introduction.examTips: Know how issues are created from assessment findings and tracked through remediation. Understand the continuous monitoring options.

topics.name: Other Application Relationships
topics.description: Understand how TPRM integrates with other ServiceNow applications and external systems.

introduction.overview: TPRM doesn't operate in isolation. It integrates with GRC, Vendor Management, and other ServiceNow applications to provide comprehensive risk management.
introduction.whyItMatters: Application Relationships covers 6% of the CIS-TPRM exam. Understanding integrations maximizes TPRM effectiveness.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the key integrations with GRC, Vendor Management, and CMDB. Understand how data flows between applications.
introduction.examTips: Focus on GRC integration and how TPRM relates to broader risk management. Know which applications share data with TPRM.
